content:
Asha B: Quick thread 10m  proposing tighter autoscale row for dense dashboards. Decisions: slider snap (5% vs 1%), min/max inline typing UX, and burst CTA copy.

Ken F: Prefer default 5%, reveal 'Fine' 1% mode when user interacts with the numeric value. Keep UI compact.

Marta (FE): Implementation: numeric input + visible +/- steppers, arrow keys change by step, Shift+arrow = +10. Will prototype.

Ibrahim (a11y): A11y checklist: inputs labeled (visually hidden ok), slider must expose aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow, steppers need aria-labels, modal traps focus. Announce SLO changes via aria-live polite.

Asha B: Burst modal copy draft: "Enable burst: +{n} GPUs for up to {t} minutes. Billed while active." CTA: "Enable burst (+{n}, {t}m)". Secondary: "Don't enable". Add "How burst billing works" link.

Ken F: Add auto-revert checkbox "Auto-revert after burst period" with tooltip. CTA should not be generic.

Marta (FE): I'll add presets popover (50/75/95) collapsed under "Presets" chevron to save space.

Ibrahim (a11y): Popover needs aria-expanded, focus management, and announce when a preset is applied. Also ensure badge contrast meets AA.

ux-bot: Prototype uploaded: https://redwood.design/figma/autoscale-compact-iter (uploaded by Asha B) :white_check_mark:

Asha B: Action items: Marta 1 prototype (Thu), Ibrahim 1 full aria attr list, Ken 1 finalize copy and cost estimate availability. Closing after prototype review.
